a: Every engagement is defined in a written statement of work setting out the outcome, what is in and out of scope, the fixed price, and the timetable. Changes to scope are agreed in writing before they're worked on.
Fixed-price work is typically invoiced 50% on commencement and 50% on completion; retainers monthly in advance. Payment terms are 14 days. Expenses are charged at cost and agreed in advance.
On payment, you own everything built specifically for you. We retain rights in our pre-existing tools, methods and know-how, and may reuse general learning that doesn't identify you or your data.
Mutual confidentiality applies from the first conversation and survives the engagement. We don't name clients or share results without written permission.
Where we process personal data on your behalf we act as processor under your instructions, and a data-processing agreement forms part of the statement of work.
We will tell you before starting if we hold an investment, board or advisory position that could conflict with the work, and we won't advise two parties on the same transaction.
Liability is capped at the fees paid under the relevant statement of work, excluding matters that can't be limited by law. Professional indemnity insurance is held; details on request.
